name: stale_aggregate
description: In `ship_lineitem`, `o_totalprice` in the `orders` table is a cached aggregate of line item prices (extendedprice * (1 - discount) * (1 + tax)), but when line items are shipped/updated, only `o_latest_shipdate` is recalculated while `o_totalprice` is never recalculated from the current lineitem rows. The `get_order` endpoint serves this potentially stale `o_totalprice` without recomputing it from lineitem details.
